ticket.subject: Network Connectivity Issue
ticket.summary: Remote employee unable to access company resources.
ticket.description: User reports they can't access internal resources (SharePoint, Teams) from their laptop. Internet browsing works but all company apps are timing out or showing connection errors.

emails.preview: Just to add, this started this morning after I…
emails.body: Just to add, this started this morning after I connected to the company VPN. Before that everything was working normally. Teams shows a 'disconnected' banner and SharePoint will not load at all.

emails.preview: Still seeing the same issue after restarting…
emails.body: Still seeing the same issue after restarting my laptop. Regular websites open fine, but every internal company app keeps timing out.
